description: Monte Carlo simulation of a portfolio: geometric Brownian motion with a contribution (or withdrawal) at the end of every step, up to 10,000 paths (paths x steps at most 5 million), deterministic for a given seed. Returns the spread of final values (percentiles 5 to 95, mean with its standard error and the exact expected value, probability of ending below the net amount invested, probability of ending a step at or below a ruin level) and a fan of 5th, 50th and 95th percentile bands over time, instead of one number. A value that would go below zero is floored at zero. Constant return and volatility, no fees or taxes: a model of spread, not a forecast. Use when user asks "what range of outcomes can my portfolio end in", "how likely is it that I run out of money withdrawing X a month" or "simulate my savings plan".

annualReturnPct.description: Expected growth mu in percentage points per year, -100 to 500.

contributionPerStep.description: Added at the END of every step; negative is a withdrawal. Default 0.

initialValue.description: Starting value, 0 to 1e12. 0 is allowed only with a positive contribution.

paths.description: Simulated paths, 100 to 10000 (paths x steps at most 5 million). Default 2000.

ruinBelow.description: A path counts as ruined once it ends a step at or below this value. Default 0.

seed.description: Random seed, 0 to 4294967295; the same input and seed give the same result. Default 1.

stepsPerYear.description: Steps (and contributions) per year, 1 to 365. Default 12.

volatilityPct.description: Annual volatility sigma in percentage points, 0 to 500.

years.description: Horizon in years, above 0 and at most 50. years x stepsPerYear must be a whole number.

name: workflow.run_monte_carlo
title: Monte Carlo Simulation
